apps.name: Streets of Rage 2 Classic
apps.localizedDescription: Dive into the legendary action of Streets of Rage 2 Classic — the iconic arcade game from SEGA that transports you to a world of street brawls and hardcore fights. Assemble a team of four fighters, each with their own unique moves, and set out to take down the criminal syndicate led by Mr. X. The game is filled with fast-paced action, atmospheric music, and nostalgic 90s graphics. Play through levels solo or with a friend, fending off waves of enemies and defeating bosses. Level up your skills and restore order to the streets!
